items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Old man Johnnie Censie or somebody like that, you know, to come and make that night.

ctx.x: Well how did those three saxophones work? Did they all play one?

They sound good, they harmonize together good. Mm-hmm. And we, on the end, we had tenor, Clown's Hall. Mm-hmm. Clown's Hall working the day at Illinois Central Railroad and work every night with us down there. That was the whole, that went through all the whole week that you all? Every night. You didn't have a night off? Mm-hmm. I had Monday night off. Yeah. Somebody paid the place? Everybody, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Uh, Buddy Charles used to be in there sometime, used to get, get Flusia, Sidney Flusia to come back.…
Oh yeah. He didn't pay that much?
